subject: Next steps: Security intake (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) + clarifying questions
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Parsons <olivia.parsons@healthbridge.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Security intake (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) + clarifying questions

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a short list of clarifying asks so we can get your questionnaire started and map owners on our side.

Recap (from our discovery)
- You’re evaluating Redwood for document ingestion and summarization inside HealthBridge’s clinician portal; PCI is not in scope, but PHI will be processed for a subset of flows.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA/BAA coverage, EU data residency for a small pilot, and proof of encryption/key control.

Options we discussed
1) SIG (standardized questionnaire) — fastest route for procurement and security review; we can prefill many answers and deliver an evidence bundle.
2) CAIQ (Cloud Security Alliance) — vendor-friendly, slightly more cloud-centric.
3) Custom short-form (one-off) — we can produce a 10–15 question custom sheet focused on PHI handling and KMS/SSO specifics.

Clarifying questions (can you confirm these with your Security/Compliance owner?):
- Preferred intake format: SIG, CAIQ, or custom short form? If SIG, do you want the full SIG or the SIG-lite (prefill + evidence pointers)?
- SOC 2: you requested our latest Type II report — is a redacted copy sufficient for now?
- HIPAA: is a signed BAA required ahead of pilot or acceptable to have it in parallel with the evaluation?
- Data residency: pilot will require EU region storage for a subset of records — which region(s) (e.g., eu-west-1)?
- Evidence owners: who from HealthBridge should we send the prefilled questionnaire and evidence links to (name + email)?

Proposed next steps / timeline
- Confirm preferred intake format and evidence recipient(s) by EOD Wed (7/16).
- We’ll prefill the chosen form and return an evidence index within 48 hours.
- If you want a technical walkthrough of our private deployment options (VPC + KMS), we can schedule a 30-min deep dive this week.

I’ve attached a short decision matrix that outlines tradeoffs and a stubbed evidence index. Attaching: redwood-sig-vs-caiq-decision-matrix.xlsx (1 page).

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sig-vs-caiq-decision-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Olivia Parsons <olivia.parsons@healthbridge.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Security intake (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) + clarifying questions

Thanks Sean — good summary. Quick answers below while I confirm with our security lead (looping procurement for timelines).

- Intake format: Preference is SIG if you can provide a SIG-lite prefill. Procurement likes SIG because it maps to our intake tooling.
- SOC 2: We need the latest Type II; a redacted PDF is fine initially. When will you be able to share that?
- HIPAA / BAA: We’ll require a signed BAA before any PHI is shared in the pilot. Legal expects the BAA to be in place, but we can start the questionnaire in parallel.
- Data residency: For the EU subset, eu-west-1 is preferred. We’ll confirm exact buckets after the prefill.
- Evidence recipients: send to olivia.parsons@healthbridge.com and copied to security@healthbridge.com. Security owner is Marco Alvarez (marco.alvarez@healthbridge.com) — I’ll confirm the mailing list.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood’s hosted offering or Dedicated capacity is recommended for the pilot when PHI is in scope? Procurement asked for a short pros/cons note.

Cheers,
Olivia Parsons
Head of IT Compliance
HealthBridge
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Parsons <olivia.parsons@healthbridge.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marco.alvarez@healthbridge.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 12:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Security intake (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) + clarifying questions

Hi Olivia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround.

We’ll proceed with SIG-lite prefill and will aim to get the redacted SOC 2 Type II over to you by EOD Wednesday (7/16). I’ve added Marco to the thread — welcome Marco.

Quick answers to the pilot hosting question:
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to stand up for evaluation, we offer logical separation and strict access controls; however, because PHI is involved you’ll likely prefer Dedicated capacity or our Private deployment to meet legal/KMS requirements.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools with per-customer tenancy, integrates with customer-managed VPC peering in many regions and can be configured with customer KMS for key management; good middle ground for predictable throughput and contractual SLAs.
- Private (on-prem/VPC): full control, ideal if your security team requires customer-managed networking and HSM-backed keys — longer lead time and heavier ops.

I’ll attach an evidence index CSV and a short pros/cons note for procurement. Proposed immediate actions:
1) I’ll send SIG-lite prefill + evidence index to olivia.parsons@healthbridge.com and security@healthbridge.com by 7/16 EOD.
2) Legal: we’ll prepare a BAA template for HealthBridge review and target signature in parallel (can you share your procurement timeline?).
3) Schedule a 30-min technical runbook call w/ Marco, Rishi (our security SME), and your infra lead — proposed slots Thu 7/17 09:00–10:00 PT or Thu 7/17 13:00–14:00 PT.

Attachments: requested-evidence-index.csv (CSV), redwood-hosting-pros-cons.pdf (PDF).

Thanks — Sean

Attachment: requested-evidence-index.csv (csv), redwood-hosting-pros-cons.pdf (pdf)

Subject: RE: Next steps: Security intake (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) + clarifying questions

Hi Olivia / Marco — looping in quickly from security side. A few items I’ll cover on the technical call and in the prefill:
- SOC 2: we’ll provide a redacted Type II PDF and an evidence map linking to the specific controls being demonstrated.
- BAA: Redwood supports a standard BAA; we’ll attach our template with the prefill. Legal note: if HealthBridge requires additional amendments (e.g., specific data destruction clauses), please flag them early.
- Encryption & keys: Redwood supports both customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private and managed keys for Hosted. For PHI we recommend Dedicated + customer KMS; I’ll bring our KMS integration checklist to the call.
- Logs & audit: we can provide audit log extracts for the pilot period and a sample retention policy in the evidence bundle.

Please confirm which slot works for your infra/security team for the 30-min call and we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
